# Examples of gRPC server, client and rest gateway autogenerated from collections of .proto files.
This project was created with educational purpose. It is not production ready.
Code generated using [protoc-gen-go](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf-go).

There are several other dependant repositories:
* [gRPC Client](https://github.com/OleksUMD/grpc_test_client)
* [gRPC Server](https://github.com/OleksUMD/grpc_test_server)
* [REST Gateway](https://github.com/OleksUMD/grpc_rest_gateway)
